name: Evidence standard
description: Says a goal is met when the outcome is present, declares no coverage gap, was not refused and holds every requirement of the done-standard, by pure functions over the done-evidence code.
advantages: Free and structural: a set that was not fully processed is never called done by its prose.
disadvantages: It checks structure and named requirements, not whether prose claims are true.

name: Outcome is not empty
description: Says a goal is met when the outcome is not empty: what a flow with no completion check implies.
disadvantages: Calls any text done, including a refusal or a half-processed set; it is the bound the evidence standard has to beat.
